acceptanceCriteria.text: The Add-folder action is AVAILABLE inside a room Files collection (not only on real on-disk folders), creating a NESTED room folder. @390 screenshot: opening a room Files collection shows an Add-folder affordance; firing it creates a nested folder.

★ Architect MEASURED (b3c8981c3) the room on-disk home = getRoomDir(userToken,roomId) = data/users/<storageId>/rooms/<roomId>/ (PER-USER, storageId-keyed, R40.22 chokepoint). RECOMMENDED TARGET: getRoomDir(...)/files/<nestedPath>/ — mkdir THROUGH the homeKeyFor chokepoint, NEVER a raw path. ★ REMAINING OPEN SUB-QUESTION (Tron/PO scope call, do-not-guess=>RED): storage is per-user AND files are shared-across-rooms, so is a nested room folder (i) PER-USER (each member mkdirs in their own home — matches today's storage model) OR (ii) CANONICAL PER-ROOM (one shared folder needing a share/sync mechanism = bigger scope)? Architect RECOMMENDS (i). Not buildable until (i)/(ii) is CONFIRMED; the chain (Class/Method) stays null until the storage MODEL is locked — no fabricated path.

Once the storage target is defined: Add-folder-in-room mints the folder scenario-UNIT **AND** mkdirs the REAL directory at that per-room target (same Tron BOTH ruling as R40.70 part 2). Fail-clean: dir-exists / invalid-name / mint-fails-after-mkdir => leave nothing behind (half-created worse than failed).

The nested room folder appears LIVE in the room tree with NO reload [browser 1] AND a second browser updates over WS [rides R40.70 AC-create-live-no-reload + AC-broadcast/2nd-passive-client]. reload-to-see = FAIL; single-browser-only = FAIL.
The nested room folder is a REAL Folder scenario-unit (rides R40.16, NO duplicate folder model).

stub-must-fail: Add-folder-in-room that creates a unit but NO physical directory (or a directory but no unit) => RED; Add-folder built against an UNDEFINED storage target => RED (must not guess the location).
